Consonantal i

Household, washing & chores

close verb

shut

also shut

classical

claudō, claudere, clausī, clausum

verb, third conjugation

Examples

  • Jānuam claude.

    Close the door.composed

  • Cum autem redieritis, jānua mea clausa erit; nōlī intrāre, nisi avia tēcum veniet.

    But when you come back, my door will be shut; don’t come in unless Grandma comes with you.Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

See also open, key.

SourcesLewis & Short: claudo

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
